channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Frank Kaminsky | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Frank Kaminsky from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Monty Williams on Frank Kaminsky
item.description:
Monty Williams on Frank Kaminsky:

“It was a tough decision for us to have to make, but I had a good conversation with Frank and he was typical Frank. Understood, but still dealing with that decision. He meant a lot to us and me personally.”

Monty Williams on Frank Kaminsky, Apr 8, 2022. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Monty Williams on Frank Kaminsky
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on Kaminsky's return:

“Frank is a guy that knows our system, that knows what we do... Frank was good for us before he went down last year, and we haven't forgotten that”

Monty Williams on Frank Kaminsky, Dec 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: James Jones on Dario Saric, Aron Baynes, Frank Kaminsky, Cheick Diallo, Deandre Ayton
item.description:
James Jones:

“This year we have from Frank [Kaminsky], Dario [Saric], Cheick [Diallo]...we can play Deandre [Ayton] at power forward if we need to, with Aron Baynes as our center.”

James Jones on Dario Saric, Aron Baynes, Frank Kaminsky, Cheick Diallo, Deandre Ayton, Sep 19, 2019. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on Frank Kaminsky
item.description:
Burns and Gambo on 98.7: Rubio on having Kaminsky, Saric spread the floor:

“The game is changing where you need almost 5 guys on the floor who can really shoot. They spread the floor and open up things. I'm looking forward to playing with them because we have the pieces to make something special.”

Ricky Rubio on Frank Kaminsky, Jul 10, 2019. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rich Cho on Frank Kaminsky
item.description:
Charlotte Hornets General Manager Rich Cho announced today that the team has exercised its third-year option on forward/center Frank Kaminsky.

“We are excited to keep Frank Kaminsky as a part of our team’s core,”

Rich Cho on Frank Kaminsky, Oct 30, 2016. Source: NBA.com.
